translations.web: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Blessed are those who know the joyful sound, who walk, O LORD, in the light of Your presence.
translations.kjv: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.
translations.asv: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: They walk, O Jehovah, in the light of thy countenance.
